nodes.name: Allow List
nodes.notes: The tool workflows the test scripts call through tests/run-case.sh (tests/tool-cases.tsv, tests/lib/n8n.sh, tests/dialog.sh, tests/cleanup.sh, tests/state.sh, tests/escalation-reset-live.sh). Each value is WFID:<name>: n8n-push.sh puts the live id there, n8n-pull.sh reads it back. tests/test-harness-stubs.sh checks the list against those scripts.

nodes.name: Unpack
nodes.notes: Refuses (error output -> Respond Error, HTTP 500 HARNESS_ERROR) a workflow outside the Allow List and a contact_id that names a contact outside the test ranges. Reads the body from Webhook by name: its input item is the Allow List.
